title: 第15章 “男朋友”
content_zh:
第15章 “男朋友”-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》

上一章

存书签

下一章

“啊？”韩小汐顿了一下，突然想到了一个说辞，“我是他粉丝，他是我偶像。”

“切！”斯蒂芬靠回了椅背，“哄小孩呢！”他神叨叨继续说道，“我们老板那么注意公众形象的一个人，居然抱着你上车，你猜，我会信吗？”

他又看了看韩小汐现在坐着的位置，更酸地说了一句，“老板有洁癖，就你现在坐的这张沙发床，除了他本人，你是第二个。”

斯蒂芬顿了一下，“更别说你怀里现在抱着的毯子了。老板专用。”

韩小汐：……

皮蛋瘦肉粥都不香了。

要她怎么说？

难不成还能幻想影帝对自己有意思？！

她又没得幻想症！

“他……可怜我吧？”韩小汐随口应付了一下。

斯蒂芬摸着下巴，半晌，点头：“很有可能。”

韩小汐退了烧，又吃了东西，状态终于恢复了不少。

她该离开了。

总不能一直赖在别人的地盘。

至于剧组的人怎么看怎么想……

不是她该操心的，那是影帝的事情。

拍摄间隙，于清也忍不住八卦，“阿珩，你和小汐关系不错啊？”

周围的人都似有若无的在看沈珩的反应。

“于导，别乱说，一个生病的小孩而已。”沈珩脸上甚至连多余的微表情都没有。

于清笑着摇头，“你啊！还真是心善。”

沈珩跟着轻笑，“顺手帮个小忙罢了。继续拍吗？”

“好，继续。”

韩小汐收拾东西的时候，沈轩跑了过来，他今天戏份结束了。

“你还好吧？”大男孩脸上的关切不像是演的。

“嗯。好多了。”韩小汐甜甜的冲他微笑，“不过，今天不想上班了，想直接回学校休息。”

“我送你。”沈轩脱口而出。

说完也觉得自己有些唐突，找补了一句，“我反正也下班了。”

“嗯！”韩小汐没有拒绝，她现在和沈轩待在一起比较安全，“麻烦了。”

“不客气！”

斯蒂芬和郭炜都不在保姆车这里，大概都在现场盯着呢。

韩小汐也不好意思不告而别，想了半天，掏出手机，回了一条信息：【感谢沈老师的照顾，我先回学校了。】

收好手机，她冲沈轩笑了笑：“走吧。”

"Ah?" Han Xiaoxi paused and suddenly thought of a way to say it, "I am his fan and he is my idol."

"Tch!" Stephen leaned back in his chair, "She's coaxing the kids!" He continued nagging, "Our boss, a person who cares so much about his public image, actually hugged you into the car. Do you think I would believe it?"

He looked at where Han Xiaoxi was sitting now and said more bitterly, "The boss has mysophobia. On the sofa bed you are sitting on now, besides him, you are the second one."

Stephen paused, "Not to mention the blanket you are holding in your arms. It's only for the boss."

Han Xiaoxi:......

The preserved egg and lean meat porridge is no longer fragrant.

What do you want her to say?

Is it possible that I can still imagine that the actor is interested in me?!

She doesn't suffer from hallucinations!

"Does he... take pity on me?" Han Xiaoxi dealt with it casually.

Stephen touched his chin, paused for a long time, and nodded: "It's very possible."

Han Xiaoxi's fever subsided, she ate again, and her condition finally recovered a lot.

It's time for her to leave.

You can't always rely on other people's territory.

As for what the crew thinks...

It's not her thing to worry about, that's the actor's business.

During the filming break, Yu Qing couldn't help but gossip, "Aheng, you and Xiao tide have a good relationship?"

Everyone around him seemed to be watching Shen Heng's reaction.

"Director Yu, don't talk nonsense, it's just a sick child." Shen Heng didn't even have any extra micro-expressions on his face.

Yu Qing smiled and shook his head, "You! You are really kind-hearted."

Shen Heng chuckled and said, "Just a small favor. Do you want to continue filming?"

"Okay, continue."

When Han Xiaoxi was packing her things, Shen Xuan ran over. His scene was over for the day.

"Are you okay?" The concern on the big boy's face didn't look like he was acting.

"Yeah. Much better." Han Xiaoxi smiled sweetly at him, "However, I don't want to go to work today and want to go back to school to rest."

"I'll give it to you." Shen Xuan blurted out.

After saying that, I felt a little abrupt, so I added, "I'm off work anyway."

"Yes!" Han Xiaoxi did not refuse. It is safer for her to stay with Shen Xuan now, "It's troublesome."

"You're welcome!"

Stephen and Guo Wei are not here in the nanny car, they are probably watching the scene.

Han Xiaoxi was too embarrassed to leave without saying goodbye. After thinking for a long time, she took out her mobile phone and replied with a message: [Thank you, Teacher Shen, for taking care of me. I will go back to school first.】

Putting away her phone, she smiled at Shen Xuan: "Let's go."
